# Lommer

> Lommer is a product design studio based in Greece, founded in 2015. We design physical products for brands and companies, from the first concept to a finished, delivered batch, and manage their production with manufacturers in Europe.

This file is a plain-text summary of the website for AI agents and assistants. Website: https://lommer.design/

## What we do

We research the brand, the user and the material, design the product and make the prototypes. Then we take charge of production with manufacturers in Europe, and handle quality control, packaging and delivery. Most projects start with a practical question: what can be made from this material, how can this idea become a real object, how can this product be reworked.

Process: Research, Design, Prototyping, Testing, Production, Packaging & delivery.

Services:
- Bespoke products: for a brand or company, from first concept to finished batch.
- Corporate & event products: objects and accessories for brand events, campaigns and clients.
- Upcycled products: made from a manufacturer's own materials and production offcuts.

## Client work

- L'Oréal: promotional bags for a presentation for L'Oréal for the Future. We adapted products from our collection to their colours and designed custom packaging. 150 bags.
- Schweppes: event keyrings to give away at promotional events. We adapted the EvaFuda keyring to the brand's colours and designed custom packaging. 1,100 pieces.
- TEDxAcademy: goodie bags for event visitors, two years in a row, one in E.V.A. and one in cotton fabric. 3,100 bags in total.
- Muses Estate Winery: gift cases for wine bottles, designed and produced in E.V.A.

## Our collection (EvaFamily)

Our own collection of bags and accessories, launched in 2015. It is built on three ideas:
- Material: E.V.A. (lightweight, durable, waterproof, easy to clean), now with recycled content recovered from the supplier's own production waste.
- Strength: flat E.V.A. folded into shape and held together by YKK snap buttons, with no stitching.
- Less waste: made to order; leftover material becomes keyrings and bracelets; reusable packaging in recycled paper or cotton.

Products:
- EvaPack: bag secured by a sailing rope instead of a zip or lock; anti-theft design. Bronze, International Design Awards 2017.
- EvaTwo: tote from a single sheet of E.V.A. with automotive seatbelt webbing and a changeable strap. Silver, A' Design Award 2016 (Fashion & Travel Accessories Design).
- EvaPocket Crossbody: crossbody bag with interchangeable lids.
- EvaClutch: minimal clutch, case and lid joined with snap buttons; the lid can be swapped.
- Eva75: work and everyday tote with room for a laptop; seatbelt straps carry the weight.
- EvaBucket: shoulder bag with seatbelt-webbing straps, that closes with its own weight.
- EvaOri: crossbody bag shaped by folding; changeable strap.
- EvaOri Large: large, very light tote.

## Studio

The name stands for LOve Materials, MEet Requirements: we start from the material, then meet what the product has to do. Lommer is led by Alkioni Matsourdeli, founder and product designer.
